frontmatter.title: Patching Your Workflows: A Simple 'if' Statement to Prevent GitHub Actions Hacks
frontmatter.subheading: How to apply the simple, effective fix that stops malicious forked PRs from running privileged code in your repository.
frontmatter.excerpt: Fix the `pull_request_target` vulnerability now. Learn how one `if` statement can check if a PR is from a fork and prevent a major security breach.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
